name: spatial-geometry-studio
description: Offline portable solid geometry teaching studio for Windows
author: Spatial Geometry Studio

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:desktop
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/smoke.mjs && node scripts/teaching-smoke.mjs && node scripts/drag-regressions.mjs && node scripts/sphere-smoke.mjs && npm run test:dihedral && npm run test:sample && npm run test:import
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win portable --x64 && node scripts/release.mjs
scripts.package:win:folder: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --x64 --dir --publish never && node scripts/release-folder.mjs --platform win32 --arch x64
scripts.package:mac:arm64: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --arm64 --dir --publish never && node scripts/release-folder.mjs --platform darwin --arch arm64
scripts.package:mac:x64: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --x64 --dir --publish never && node scripts/release-folder.mjs --platform darwin --arch x64
scripts.package:mac:universal: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --universal --dir --publish never && node scripts/release-folder.mjs --platform darwin --arch universal
